rules.statement: For the purpose of reckoning the period of prescription, the action against a company must be taken to have been instituted on the date of the original plaint and not upon the amendment of the caption of the plaint.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, that, for the purpose of reckoning the period of prescription, the action against the company must be taken to have been instituted on the date of the original plaint and not upon the amendment of the caption of the plaint.

meta.parties: C. A. Odiris Silva & Sons, Ltd. v. Jayawardene, P
